summary.text: Tram Nguyen is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives for the 18th Essex District, which includes parts of Andover, Boxford, North Andover and Tewksbury, and was elected in 2018.
The Legislature's committee listing shows her as Chair of the House Committee on Climate Action and Sustainability.

paragraphs.text: Tram T. Nguyen's official biography describes her as a first-generation Vietnamese American immigrant and the first in her family to graduate from college and law school.
It lists a B.A. from Tufts University in 2008, a J.D. from Northeastern University School of Law in 2013 and a Master in Public Administration from the Harvard Kennedy School in 2024.
Before public service she was a legal aid attorney at Greater Boston Legal Services, working with domestic violence survivors, low-wage workers, veterans, seniors and children.
The biography says she was the first Vietnamese American woman elected to public office in Massachusetts and the first Vietnamese American elected to the Massachusetts House.

It says she has served as Co-Chair of the Special Commission on Structural Racism in the Massachusetts Probation Service and as Chair of the House Committee on Climate Action and Sustainability, the first Asian American woman to chair a House committee.
